notes.title: HUGE UPDATE Released
notes.content:
[h1]HUGE Update Released[/h1]

Hello again [b]Monstermörder's[/b] here are the update release notes.

First off, lead man IGS Ghost wants you all to know that this is a work in progress.  Not every beginning of every game has all that is going to be in the game.  He intends on adding quite a bit more content in the future.  He has been learning to develop for a little more than 2 years now and has gained a lot of knowledge along the way.  This is his love and he wants you to know it.

[h3][b]GAME DEMO[/b][/h3]
You can now try out the game by playing the demo.  You will have limited access to game features but you have a whole map to explore.  Make sure to check out all the buildings and a hidden compass marker will appear that points you to a place you HAVE to see.  If you are playing the demo and not sure about purchasing, please reach out to us on discord and ask any questions you may have.  Also, please give any feedback so we can make the game better for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/38dff758ef9c974da1c0775a0a19a778c9bcdf9f.png[/img]

[h3][b]TRAINING CAMP[/b][/h3]
We added a [b]Training Camp[/b] level to let you try out everything in the game and get a feel for how it works.  To get there, choose that level when you are starting your game.  You must exit this level and pick the Bienenstock level to actually play the game though.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/eda617c60f785574dc8c24c74c526d50472a4d58.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/d54629fac5e4cc92b13664a9eee7522fa0a47da1.png[/img]

[h3][b]COMBAT SYSTEM[/b][/h3]
We mentioned about updating the combat system, and we have added some new human enemies to worry about.  We have also added a melee weapon for all your monster slicing needs.  Monsters have been modified and are a bit tougher to deal with.  Speaking of monsters.... who wants a trophy of their hard work?  Now you can create a mount for your monsters and place them in your house.  You are, after all, striving to be a professional monster killer.  You can get skins from a few different monsters and with other crafting materials you can craft the mount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/023d343953b42ccfdf38e11ec3651aba78cb4f7a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/c4897a3bbfa1e404d4819333ca32c2859fca3004.png[/img]

[h3][b]CRAFTING[/b][/h3]
The crafting system has been changed a little bit.  You will need upgrades (if you will) to your crafting bench in order to make higher level items.  To use these upgrades, just place the item in the world close to your crafting bench.  To get a feel for this, check out the training camp and try it out before venturing into the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/74c104d44fe08b9d1f70c5988a67ea8e3a2fa7e6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/7580f9a91dff245b6e1d330d4c55b41addf53138.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/d86fc347c246a57088f5d6603978011fa339c3b9.png[/img]

[h3][b]GAME GUIDE[/b][/h3]
[b]Red's Quick & Dirty guide[/b] will be attached to the steam page.  Please check out this guide to get started and for the known issues we have with multiplayer.  We have given you a work-a-round but are trying to get this fixed for a future update.

[u][b]Known Issues:[/b][/u]
Werewolves are giving human meat right now but will change in the future
The deer only have a head mount right now, not a full body mount, but will change in the future
Melee animation is a work in progress

Join our discord to learn more, and to chat with us while playing. The big man IGS Ghost is always around and showing off his stuff.
[url=https://discord.gg/fQsSP3bPZ9]https://discord.gg/fQsSP3bPZ9[/url]

Follow us on Twitch, catch IGS Ghost streaming the game or game development.
https://www.twitch.tv/invisibleghoststudios

notes.title: HUGE Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Monstermörders!!![/h1]

Apologies because it's been a while since we have posted anything about the game. We wanted to share with you what we have been working on, and it's exciting.

We have re-worked the game from many different aspects based on feedback we have received. Yes, I know, it's a lot, but it was needed.  We tried very hard to wait for UE5 for this, but we couldn't keep our followers waiting any longer.

[h3]A few sneak peaks[/h3]
The combat system has been updated in a way that's better. We noticed you were getting attacked in various ways that shouldn't be happening, but that is fixed now as well as adding in something special.

The crafting system has been modified and updated.  This should give players a bit more time of grinding and gives you more to do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/9c82861db6de7e57f0e5e06d20876855677e3bf3.png[/img]

The icons are fixed, they are no longer the size of the entire screen when you are dragging them. We can't get anybody to admit who dropped the ball there, but you know...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/c3c32b6e4213adfd71036bd2dc4271b8e3011182.png[/img]

Enemies and animals will work a bit different between single player and multiplayer.  When you are able, please check it out, and tell us what you like better.

We do not have a defined date yet for the update, but it is [b]HUGE[/b].  We have made new maps, we have added new content, and [b]BEST OF ALL[/b]...  multiplayer is back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/0a1cb5d4afe3ec6d9331f2963e952c04a38032c1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057135/ccf352885f70f46fe282d64c25f3f95d794be3cb.png[/img]

When we bring you this fabulous update, we will also be bringing you a game guide.  We hear you...  we know some of you are having a hard time getting started or figuring things out.  This will not be a problem anymore.  One of our developers also has a hard time figuring things out since she joined the team, she is writing up a super special employee manual for all your needs.

We have seen some more interest in Monstermörder over the past couple months.  We haven't forgotten you, nor have we forgotten Monstermörder.  This game is the Invisible Ghost Studios flagship and will never be left unfinshed.

Our team hopes this update will reignite your passion in the future.  We are looking very forward to bringing this special update out for all our current and possible future players.

[b]DON'T FORGET[/b] - once this is updated, and since multiplayer is back, if you ever see a server name (when browsing) that has IGS or IGT in front of it - join it and you will be playing with one of the IGS team.  Ask questions, give suggestions, just have fun playing with us.

Join our discord to learn more, and to chat with us while playing.  The big man IGS Ghost is always around and showing off his stuff.
https://discord.gg/fQsSP3bPZ9

Follow us on Twitch, catch IGS Ghost streaming the game or game development.
twitch link
https://www.twitch.tv/invisibleghoststudios

notes.title: New Beta Version
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

We have made a Beta version of the game for anyone wanting to play with all the new features we have added.  To access this version, right click on Monstermoerder in your Steam Library and then click on Properties.  On the left click on Betas, then on the right side click the drop-down and select beta - Test Beta Branch.  Once you game updates, you will have the most recent version that we are working on.

There will be bugs, but please let us know what you think either here on Steam or in our Discord channel.
https://discord.gg/fQsSP3bPZ9

We are heading back to the roots of our story.  We have changed quite a bit, and are currently fine tuning all the new things.

Here is a list of what is new:

[b]The Hive[/b] - your spacestation, which is a place where you can find vendors and a special room that has planetary gates to take you to various places where you can explore/build/loot.
[b]Planetary gates[/b] - now you will use portals to move between different locations
New volcanic location - here is the only place you will find precious ores, but beware it is quite treacherous
[b]Choppable Trees/Breaking rocks[/b] - now trees will chop down into logs, and stones/ores will break into collectable pieces
[b]New ballistic effects[/b] - new footsteps based on terrain, water effects, and blood splatter from animals, just shoot stuff and listen to and see what it does
[b]New vendor[/b] - this one has houses
[b]Starting Character[/b] - you now start with a gun that has a magazine and ammo
[b]New lootable items[/b] - just added some more lootable items around the maps

A companion - Who doesn't enjoy a friendly fluffy little animal by your side? We added a dog which you can tame and have him follow you around. Created garbage collection for items left in the world, they will now de-spawn
Added sounds on The Rocky Canyon map

Bugs fixed:

Doors on cabins would sometimes not spawn
Allowed apples to be stack-able
Allowed bandages to be stack-able
Allowed beans to be stack-able

notes.title: Big update for Story Mode
notes.content:
Multiplayer:  For now multiplayer unfortunately is pulled.  We are working hard to bring it back, but we ran into to many issues.  We would rather give you a well functioning game instead of a game with many issues.  

Story Mode: Added a new map.  Added new monsters.  Careful you can now be poisoned, wounded, sick or drunk.  What you eat or monsters can make you this way.  There are ways to get healthy though.  We hope you enjoy the story mode as we keep adding.  We have big plans for the story mode as we keep working on the multiplayer issues we encountered.

notes.title: Dev Note
notes.content:
Hello Everyone.  It's time for a much-needed update about what we have been working on.  The open world survival game is coming together nicely.  We hope you enjoy the new update. 

First off, we have had some setbacks but we invested in our infrastructure to make sure those setbacks don't happen again.  For example, losing the whole project and having to rebuilt it from the ground up.  We were also able to snatch up another developer for our team (IGS Redbarnacles), so sometimes good things come from bad situations. Swing by our Discord and you just might catch IGS Ghost streaming while he is working on the game.
